# Remote Yoga Coach

> Remote Yoga Coach delivers live weekly wellbeing sessions, breathing, meditation and chair yoga, to remote and hybrid teams over Microsoft Teams or Zoom. It is built for HR and people leaders who want a wellbeing habit their distributed team actually attends and can measure, rather than a passive app nobody opens. Sessions are led by the same coach each week, camera optional, and every session is recorded.

Key facts:
- Format: live, online, 15 to 30 minute sessions on Teams or Zoom. The same coach every week. Camera optional, no equipment, no experience needed.
- Audience: HR, people and culture leaders, team leads and founders at remote-first and hybrid companies of roughly 10 to 100 people (tech, consulting, sustainability, distributed teams).
- Coverage: delivered in English across UK and European time zones, with Australian hours for part of the year. Every session recorded for other time zones.
- Model: a flat monthly subscription priced by session frequency (not per person), starting with a single taster session that is credited to the first month.
- Pricing (SEK, ex VAT): single taster session 1,490 kr (credited to first month); Starter 2,990 kr (twice a month); Weekly 4,990 kr (weekly); Enterprise from 8,900 kr (more than weekly or across time zones) per month, flat per team, any team size. Roughly two months free with annual billing.
- Differentiator: a live, familiar human coach builds the habit and accountability that passive wellbeing apps and reactive EAPs cannot. Positioned as the missing live layer, not a replacement for existing tools.
- Measurement: every programme reports attendance, repeat attendance and pre/post wellbeing, summarised in a one-page report for leadership.
- Contact: hello@remoteyogacoach.com. Book a taster at https://remoteyogacoach.com/demo

## Services
- [Corporate wellbeing for remote teams](https://remoteyogacoach.com/services/corporate-wellbeing-for-remote-teams): the core offer, a live weekly wellbeing subscription for distributed and hybrid teams.
- [How it works, The Weekly Reset](https://remoteyogacoach.com/services/team-wellness): what a live session involves, its structure, and why it fits distributed teams.
- [Office yoga and chair yoga for teams](https://remoteyogacoach.com/services/chair-yoga-for-teams): live virtual office yoga and chair yoga for companies, gentle seated movement any workforce can do at a desk, whether remote, hybrid or in an office.
- [Pricing](https://remoteyogacoach.com/pricing): transparent monthly tiers and the single taster session.
- [Compare: live sessions vs apps vs EAPs](https://remoteyogacoach.com/compare): how live wellbeing sessions differ from wellbeing apps and employee assistance programmes on the metric that matters, whether teams actually use it.

- [Mindfulness at work: does it work for teams?](https://remoteyogacoach.com/guides/mindfulness-at-work): what workplace mindfulness is, the evidence, and how to run meditation and breathing as a team habit.
